task: WhatsApp notification capture, permission recovery, hand/pin flow and current AI preview context only
deliverable: Patched source project ZIP. Not an installable APK.
scopePreservation: All original project files not listed as changed are copied byte-for-byte from the uploaded archive. No UI redesign, new dependencies, provider registry changes, app identity changes, signing changes or unrelated runtime changes.
changes: Serialize native settings reads behind migration; refresh and await the current sharing state plus newest preview data before every registered foreground provider call, including retries and regeneration.
Never report an unverified switch as OFF. A permitted but empty/failed preview result is distinguished from disabled sharing. Old assistant claims are not treated as current app state.
Recover current active selected-source notifications after Android listener connection and on explicit reconnect. Does not read WhatsApp databases or chat history.
Accept readable text notifications even without MessagingStyle or an inline reply action, while excluding ongoing service notifications, group summaries, calls, blank text and expired notifications.
Offer Show captured previews with explicit hand/pin actions, independent of AI permission. Recover missed popups when the app resumes.
An explicit tap on a Horizon preview notification opens and pins the corresponding local preview, even if in-app popup preference is off.
Denied notification runtime prompts fall back to Android notification settings. The separate Android listener permission is explained.
Maintain consent, source selection, lock, expiry, encrypted-storage bounds, draft-only behavior and disabled send endpoints.

legacyRequestedFixesBrowser.reason: HorizonBridges.inbox is not a function: the old harness references an already removed inbox API. Reproduced unchanged against the uploaded baseline. No unrelated runtime code altered to satisfy this obsolete test.

validation.mocking: Chromium uses mocked native Android bridge and intercepted provider HTTP. Test credentials are synthetic, and are never used for live inference.

providers.reason: The optional two new no-billing providers were not added: no additional pair was verified for both recurring free availability and working authentication/inference. No unverified services were labelled as working.
providers.findings: The retrieved SambaNova plans page says to add a payment method and purchase credits. The retrieved Cerebras model catalog describes Free Trial and Pay as You Go tiers, not a guaranteed recurring free tier.

installation: Use the included existing Android build workflow and the same app ID and release signing key as the installed app. The ZIP itself cannot be installed.
Do not uninstall the existing app merely to bypass a signing mismatch; uninstalling can remove chats/settings. No signing key was provided or changed here.
After installing the rebuilt app, open Settings > Permissions > Notification reply drafts.
Enable Allow notifications, then separately use Grant notification access to enable Horizon WhatsApp access in Android.
Select Personal WhatsApp and/or WhatsApp Business; enable Allow toast pop-ups for the hand/pin popup and Allow background preview alerts for Horizon alerts while away.
Enable Allow AI to see pinned messages. Enable Let AI see my latest previews only if you also want unpinned previews shared with the selected AI provider.
Receive a new visible WhatsApp notification and tap the hand, or use Show captured previews. Check / reconnect reads listener health without enabling private sharing automatically.
limitations: Cannot bypass Android restricted settings, notification access permission, OEM battery restrictions, hidden/redacted WhatsApp previews or WhatsApp notification settings.
No full chat-history access or automatic WhatsApp sending was added.
A provider response was exercised with mocked transport, not a real API key; all provider uptime/free-tier availability remains outside app control.
Unrelated original version metadata and existing release workflow are preserved.
